declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_above
declarations.header:
private theorem exists_above (xs : List Int) :
    ∃ z : Int, ∀ x ∈ xs, x < z

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_below
declarations.header:
private theorem exists_below (xs : List Int) :
    ∃ z : Int, ∀ x ∈ xs, z < x

declarations.header:
theorem ordered_index_injective [LinearOrder α] (xs : List α) (hd : xs.Nodup) :

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_fresh_set_changes
declarations.header:
theorem exists_fresh_set_changes (xs : List Int) (k i : Nat)
    (hd : xs.Nodup) (hk : k < xs.length) (hi : i < xs.length) :
    ∃ z : Int, z ∉ xs ∧
      (ordered (xs.set i z))[k]? ≠ (ordered xs)[k]?

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_set_changes
declarations.header:
theorem exists_set_changes (xs : List Int) (k i : Nat)
    (hd : xs.Nodup) (hk : k < xs.length) (hi : i < xs.length) :
    ∃ z : Int, (ordered (xs.set i z))[k]? ≠ (ordered xs)[k]?

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.sortSelect_set_changes
declarations.header:
theorem sortSelect_set_changes (xs : List Int) (k i : Nat)
    (hd : xs.Nodup) (hk : k < xs.length) (hi : i < xs.length) :
    ∃ z : Int, sortSelect (k + 1) (xs.set i z) ≠ sortSelect (k + 1) xs

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.selectWith_set_changes
declarations.header:
theorem selectWith_set_changes (choose : List Int → Option Int)
    (hv : PivotValid choose) (xs : List Int) (k i : Nat)
    (hd : xs.Nodup) (hk : k < xs.length) (hi : i < xs.length) :
    ∃ z : Int, selectWith choose (k + 1) (xs.set i z) ≠
      selectWith choose (k + 1) xs

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.ofFn_update
declarations.header:
theorem ofFn_update (input : Fin n → α) (i : Fin n) (z : α) :
    List.ofFn (Function.update input i z) = (List.ofFn input).set i.val z

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateSensitivity.exists_update_changes
declarations.header:
theorem exists_update_changes (input : Fin n → Int) (k i : Fin n)
    (hd : Function.Injective input) :
    ∃ z : Int,
      (ordered (List.ofFn (Function.update input i z)))[k.val]? ≠
        (ordered (List.ofFn input))[k.val]?

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.Runs.deterministic
declarations.header:
theorem Runs.deterministic (run : Runs next input history trace value)
    (run' : Runs next input history trace' value') :

declarations.header:
theorem Runs.queries_all {next : Protocol n Int Int} {input : Fin n → Int}
    {trace : Transcript n Int} {value : Int} (run : Runs next input [] trace value)
    (k : Fin n) (correct : Selects next k) (distinct : Function.Injective input) :

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.Runs.length_lower_bound
declarations.header:
theorem Runs.length_lower_bound {next : Protocol n Int Int} {input : Fin n → Int}
    {trace : Transcript n Int} {value : Int} (run : Runs next input [] trace value)
    (k : Fin n) (correct : Selects next k) (distinct : Function.Injective input) :
    n ≤ trace.length

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.queryWork
declarations.header: def queryWork (tariff : Fin n → α → Nat) : Transcript n α → Nat

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.queryWork_nil
declarations.header: theorem queryWork_nil (tariff : Fin n → α → Nat) : queryWork tariff [] = 0

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.queryWork_cons
declarations.header:
theorem queryWork_cons (tariff : Fin n → α → Nat) (i : Fin n) (a : α)
    (rest : Transcript n α) :
    queryWork tariff ((i, a) :: rest) = tariff i a + queryWork tariff rest

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.queryWork_unit
declarations.header:
theorem queryWork_unit (trace : Transcript n α) :
    queryWork (fun _ _ => 1) trace = trace.length

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.queryWork_constant
declarations.header:
theorem queryWork_constant (c : Nat) (trace : Transcript n α) :
    queryWork (fun _ _ => c) trace = c * trace.length

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.length_le_queryWork
declarations.header:
theorem length_le_queryWork (tariff : Fin n → α → Nat)
    (positive : ∀ i a, 1 ≤ tariff i a) (trace : Transcript n α) :
    trace.length ≤ queryWork tariff trace

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.Runs.work_lower_bound
declarations.header:
theorem Runs.work_lower_bound {next : Protocol n Int Int} {input : Fin n → Int}
    {trace : Transcript n Int} {value : Int} (run : Runs next input [] trace value)
    (k : Fin n) (correct : Selects next k) (distinct : Function.Injective input)
    (tariff : Fin n → Int → Nat) (positive : ∀ i a, 1 ≤ tariff i a) :
    n ≤ queryWork tariff trace

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.Runs.resource_lower_bound
declarations.header:
theorem Runs.resource_lower_bound {next : Protocol n Int Int} {input : Fin n → Int}
    {trace : Transcript n Int} {value : Int} (run : Runs next input [] trace value)
    (k : Fin n) (correct : Selects next k) (distinct : Function.Injective input)
    (tariff : Fin n → Int → Nat) (positive : ∀ i a, 1 ≤ tariff i a)
    (resource : Nat) (coversQueries : queryWork tariff trace ≤ resource) :
    n ≤ resource

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.exists_linear_run
declarations.header:
theorem exists_linear_run (next : Protocol n Int Int) (k : Fin n)
    (total : Total next) (correct : Selects next k) :
    ∃ (input : Fin n → Int) (trace : Transcript n Int) (value : Int),
      Function.Injective input ∧ Runs next input [] trace value ∧ n ≤ trace.length

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.linear_worst_case_bound
declarations.header:
theorem linear_worst_case_bound
    (next : (m : Nat) → Protocol (m + 1) Int Int) (k : (m : Nat) → Fin (m + 1))
    (total : ∀ m, Total (next m)) (correct : ∀ m, Selects (next m) (k m))
    (bound : Nat → Nat)
    (upper : ∀ m input trace value,
      Runs (next m) input [] trace value → trace.length ≤ bound (m + 1))
    (m : Nat) : m + 1 ≤ bound (m + 1)

declarations.name: Applications.Selection.CoordinateQueries.linear_isBigO_of_query_bound
declarations.header:
theorem linear_isBigO_of_query_bound
    (next : (m : Nat) → Protocol (m + 1) Int Int) (k : (m : Nat) → Fin (m + 1))
    (total : ∀ m, Total (next m)) (correct : ∀ m, Selects (next m) (k m))
    (bound : Nat → Nat)
    (upper : ∀ m input trace value,
      Runs (next m) input [] trace value → trace.length ≤ bound (m + 1)) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun m : Nat => (m : ℝ))
      (fun m => (bound m : ℝ))
